e.body:
End-to-End AutoML Insurance（kennethleungty——[[finance-llms]] 作者，83★）是保险交叉销售的端到端 AutoML 管道：H2O AutoML 训练 + MLflow 追踪 + FastAPI 服务 + Streamlit 界面（健康险交叉销售数据——识别对车险感兴趣的客户）。对 RIAA：保险 ML 工程化的完整示例——AutoML（[[insolver]] 低代码 ML 对照）+ MLOps（[[insurance-mlops]] 配套）+ 部署（[[insurance-deploy]]）；交叉销售（客户价值管理）；83★ 高星教学（2022 停更但完整）；与 [[finance-llms]]（同作者）、[[insurance-pricing-course]] 配套；适合保险 ML 工程化教学。

## 同类工具
[[ergodic-insurance-limits]]、[[extreme-stats-jl]]、[[forvis-modelling-revolution]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
End-to-End AutoML Insurance (kennethleungty — the author of [[finance-llms]], 83★) is an end-to-end AutoML pipeline for insurance cross-selling: H2O AutoML training + MLflow tracking + FastAPI serving + Streamlit UI (health insurance cross-sell data — identifying customers interested in additional vehicle insurance). For RIAA: a complete insurance ML engineering example — AutoML (the low-code contrast of [[insolver]]) + MLOps (pairs with [[insurance-mlops]]) + deployment ([[insurance-deploy]]); cross-selling (customer value management); 83★ high-star teaching (not updated since 2022 but complete); pairs with [[finance-llms]] (same author) and [[insurance-pricing-course]]; suits insurance ML engineering teaching.

## Similar tools
[[ergodic-insurance-limits]]、[[extreme-stats-jl]]、[[forvis-modelling-revolution]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
